evals.prompt: Build a swappable fitted jacket with matching body morphs and a reversible covered-body mask.
evals.expected_output: An editable, scoped result with discipline-specific settings, actual evidence and stated unverified gates.
assertions: Removes temporary double deformation while preserving original body state.
Repairs weights/morphs/ease and tests evaluated critical poses.
Treats normal-ray clearance as partial and uses actual visual review.

evals.prompt: A jacket doubles motion after Surface Deform morph capture and clips during crouch. Repair without deleting the complete body.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis tied to the supplied failure, preserved sources, a concrete correction and repeated affected acceptance checks.
assertions: Removes temporary double deformation while preserving original body state.
Repairs weights/morphs/ease and tests evaluated critical poses.
Treats normal-ray clearance as partial and uses actual visual review.
Does not label a hypothetical plan, a structural assertion or unrun workflow as successful execution.
